items.title: Jasper Taylor Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: I played, played, uh, played with, uh, Jell-O Roll many times on dances, dance dates.

ctx.x: Did you ever work with him in a band up here? Yes, I have. Aside from the record that you made.
Yes, I played, played, uh, played with, uh, Jell-O Roll many times on dances, dance dates. It always went over big. Sensational.
I understood he had a band sometimes that go out of town and travel. Did you ever travel on any tour with him?
